what: In Elixir 1.20.3 a @spec alone does NOT constrain call sites: the compiler checks calls against types it infers from the callee's patterns, guards and body. A compile-time requirement must go in the function head (e.g. def center([_ | _] = points)). Dialyzer reads @spec and reports call_without_opaque when a forged %Mod{} literal reaches a function typed Mod.t(). Measured 2026-10-19.
why: The engine-types spec originally claimed the opposite; tier-2 guarantees silently do nothing if written as specs only.
